title: Model Registry Entry Compiler
description: Compiles MLflow model registry entries. Enforces model serialization format, complete metadata (params/metrics/dataset version), model card linkage, performance thresholds, reproducibility hash, and semantic versioning.

error_codes.MR003: Model metadata incomplete — params, metrics, and dataset_version must all be logged
error_codes.MR004: Model does not meet minimum performance threshold defined in spec
error_codes.MR005: Model card document not linked in registry entry
error_codes.MR006: Training config reproducibility hash not stored
error_codes.MR007: Model not tagged with semantic version or run_id
